before: A large document's first layout runs in one task and its pages appear when the last one is placed.
after: A large document mounts on a layout of its first pages and lays out the rest in short tasks; an edit during that time lays the first pages out again and starts the rest over.
reason: Only when local layout runs changes. The final layout is the same computation on the same revision, and nothing about layout enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
